response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong testing culture, mentoring instincts, and some high-throughput distributed systems exposure, but he falls well short of the core minimum qualifications: his C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (~7 months) versus the required 8 years, and his career centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure. He also lacks formal technical-leadership experience managing cross-team priorities on platform projects, making him a poor fit for this specific role despite his overall seniority.
strengths: 20 years of broad software experience across web, backend, embedded, and low-latency systems
Some large-scale, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and code katas
concerns: Far short of the required 8 years of C++ experience (only ~7 months professionally)
No production cloud compute platform or infrastructure architecture ownership at scale
No formal technical-lead role managing cross-team strategy, priorities, and deliverables

key_factors.factor: Strong general seniority and mentoring aptitude
